chunks: By Allah Who germinated the seed and created living beings,
if this is true you will be humbled in my view and you will become light in weight.
Therefore, do not treat lightly the obligations of your Lord and do not reform your world by ruining your religion, since then you will be among losers by the way of (your) actions.
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of prioritizing worldly affairs over religious obligations according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Addressing the governor of Khurasan, Imam Ali invokes the divine oath 'He who split the grain and created the soul' to underscore the gravity of his warning against prioritizing temporal administration over spiritual integrity. He cautions that compromising one's faith for worldly success leads to being among 'the losers in deeds,' a concept deeply rooted in Shia ethical governance where the ruler's accountability to God supersedes administrative efficiency.
